title: No Knockback Resistance
description: This mod removes Knockback resistance attribute from the game, which fixes the problem of wind charges/wind burst mace not working properly with netherite/knockback resistance enchant
body:
This mod removes knockback resistance from the game, which makes things like wind charges and wind burst maces work properly while wearing netherite armor/blast protection enchant.

Keep in mind this removes ALL knockback resistance, so even mobs like iron golems will take knockback.

Should probably work on servers.
